verdict.rationale: Ramp documents its own spend limits: virtual cards with per-vendor spending limits, and 'Spend programs' described as recurring-budget templates. The MCP probe also exposes limits, spend_programs and departments scopes, so a limits and program-budget construct exists in the product. However, no evidence describes department-level budgets or how limits are automatically enforced against a department or program budget, and the spend-program evidence is framed around agent purchases. Missing for 10: documented department-level budgets, explicit description of automatic enforcement against budgets (blocking or declining over-limit spend), finance-lead budget-setting workflow docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can set department or program budgets with automatically enforced spend limits

citations.quote: A finance team issues instant virtual cards for each software subscription with per-vendor spending limits
Spend programs — back agent purchases with recurring-budget templates
